The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow that can lead to assets being frozen in an incorrect amount. When balances[_from] is smaller than _value, it causes overflow, setting balances[_from] to 2^256, a situation that can be exploited to create additional funds.

The 'transfer' function has a typo in a require statement, allowing any user to transfer balances of any account. Typo in 'require(balances[msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0);' can be exploited to set balances[msg.sender] to 2^256, a situation that can be beneficial to attackers.
